diagnosis: Customer needs audit history beyond the retention window of their tier.
reply: As a premium support customer, your ticket has been placed in the priority queue. Audit log retention depends on your support tier, and entries older than the retention window are no longer available to export. The linked article explains the retention periods and the NDJSON export option for the entries that are still within the window. See "Audit log retention and export" (kb-0013) for the full details.
